title: 49:8 acceptable time/day of salvation. This phrase speaks of the period and the specific time when the Lord chooses to do his work. At least one fulfillment of this expression came in the meridian dispensation, when Paul wrote, "Behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation" (2 Cor. 6:2). Another time of fulfillment appears to be the last days, when Israel is gathered.
author: Tina M. Peterson
